verdict.rationale: Asking whether a 3D engine or its official editor ships a built-in AI assistant is a fair question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows an official assistant inside three.js or the three.js editor that generates scripts, answers API questions, or scaffolds scenes. The llms.txt and llms-full.txt files are machine-readable docs for external LLMs and coding agents, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here.
